description: The page answers 200 with no Content-Type header: critical never looks at the page content-type and processes it as HTML.

thin.note: Proposal: the page content-type must be html or xhtml, so no Content-Type header fails the job (same reading as failure-page-content-type-json); the stylesheet rules are different, there text/plain and a missing type are tolerated. The decision list covers neither: confirm before asserting this one.
